id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ceb0: "Luminary, you met the Guardian of Time! I'm a kid so I don't really get it, but that's amazing, right!
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cf74: "Take me to the Guardian of Time sometime. I want to meet them!
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d0bc: "If Kurucchi has come back, did they find the Luminary?
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d134: "I thought we could never fulfill our mission, but with the Luminary here, I see a bit of hope...
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d250: "Did you know? Kurucchi is the elder's grandchild, and they're very close.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d3c0: "Did you know? Kurucchi is the elder's grandchild, and they're very close.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d530: "Did you know? Kurucchi is the elder's grandchild, and they're very close.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d2e0: "If I have grandchildren someday, I want a relationship like those two.

id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d6a0: "The ten adventure logs are restored, but who defiled them, and why?
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d770: "Maybe the answer lies beyond the passage behind the Altar Chamber... Well, that's probably overthinking.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d8c4: "I've been wondering why we Tockles were given the mission of passing the Luminaries' true deeds to posterity.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d9ac: "Maybe our mission is to protect everyone's memories...
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|da3c: "Even the most precious memories fade. So we protect everyone's memories to keep them from being forgotten.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|db08: "If our mission keeps the Luminary's memory alive in everyone, nothing would make me happier.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dc7c: "I heard your talk with Kurucchi! You're the Luminary! Welcome to Tockle Village!
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dd14: "First, please meet the elder! He's in the Altar Chamber up the stairs!
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|de10: "Welcome, Luminary. This is Tockle Village, home of the Tockles, who watch over the course of time.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|df28: "Welcome, Luminary. This is Tockle Village, home of the Tockles, who watch over the course of time.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e040: "Welcome, Luminary. This is Tockle Village, home of the Tockles, who watch over the course of time.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e190: "Welcome, Luminary. This is Tockle Village, home of the Tockles, who watch over the course of time.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e47c: "Welcome, Luminary. This is Tockle Village, home of the Tockles, who watch over the course of time.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e278: "...No time to be calm! A mysterious passage appeared in the Altar Chamber and the elder is troubled.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e360: "The elder is in the Altar Chamber at the back of the village as always, so please hurry and hear him out.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e564: "The adventure log matter was settled safely, and peaceful days flow through Tockle Village.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e6d0: "Ugh, the elder asked me to enter the labyrinth, but a coward like me can't possibly do it, yansu.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e778: "Ah, won't someone give me courage, yansu...
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e81c: "Strangely, being near the Luminary makes courage well up, yansu.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e990: "Strangely, being near the Luminary makes courage well up, yansu.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|eb04: "Strangely, being near the Luminary makes courage well up, yansu.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e8b0: "Even a coward like me feels it. The Luminary's charisma is tremendous, yansu.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ea24: "Even a coward like me feels it. The Luminary's charisma is tremendous, yansu.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|eb98: "Even a coward like me feels it. The Luminary's charisma is tremendous, yansu.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ec94: "Luminary! They say a mysterious passage no one in the village knew has appeared at the back of the Altar Chamber, yansu!
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ed60: "But an evil presence like I've never felt drifts from there, yansu.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|edf0: "If you go beyond, you should be careful, yansu.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|eeb0: "A statue of the Luminary now stands in the Altar Chamber, yansu. It conveys your charisma. Well made.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ef9c: "From now on the Tockles will protect that statue like those of past Luminaries, so rest assured, yansu.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f37c: "This is the hat shop, chokki. With enough tickets, you can trade for stylish hats, chokki.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f430: "Meeting an out-and-about Tockle wearing a hat through StreetPass gets you one ticket for that hat, chokki.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f4f0: "Each time you get a ticket, the shop's lineup grows, so look forward to it, chokki♪
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f588: "...So, as a token of friendship, I'll give you a ticket as a special favor, chokki!
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f63c: "First trade that ticket for a hat and experience how wonderful hats are, chokki.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fa38: "Oh, {var:1}! Descendant of Erdrick! I have awaited your coming.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fad8: "Long ago, Erdrick received the Ball of Light from the gods and sealed away the monsters.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fb88: "But the Dragonlord, an incarnation of evil, appeared from nowhere and shrouded that orb in darkness.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fc38: "May peace return to this land once more!
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fc98: "Hero {var:1}! Defeat the Dragonlord and take back the Ball of Light from his hands!
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fd3c: "A gift from me! Take the treasure chest beside you!
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fdd8: "And the soldiers in this room will share their knowledge of travel with you.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fe70: "Well then, until we meet again, Hero {var:1}!
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ff0c: "When your preparations for the journey are done, come see me again. I will be waiting, {var:1}!
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1003: "When you have taken all the treasure chests, there should be a key inside.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|100c: "The key vanishes after one use, but when you open the door with it...
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1025: "When you leave this castle, there is a town next to it.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1034: "When hurt in battle, return to town and stay at the inn, and your wounds will heal.
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1050: "Half a year has passed since monsters carried the princess off...
id./param/region/r023.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1058: "The king says nothing, but he must be suffering greatly.

tm.「勇者さま まずは ６人のヨッチ族を\n 時渡りの迷宮に 送り込み\n 冒険の書: "Luminary, first send six Tockles into the Labyrinth of Time and find the password to the adventure log.
tm.「時渡りの迷宮は 祭壇の間の\n すぐとなりに ありますぞ。: "The Labyrinth of Time is right next to the Altar Chamber.
tm.「冒険の書の合言葉を見つけた\n その時から 冒険の書の世界の扉は\n すでに: "Since you found the adventure log's password, the doors to its world have been open.
tm.「さっそく 祭壇に置かれている 冒険の書を調べ\n 中の世界の様子を 確かめてく: "Examine the adventure log on the altar and see how the world inside is doing. I'm counting on you.
tm.「けがされた 冒険の書を もとに戻すため\n 集めたヨッチ族を 時渡りの迷宮に送: "To restore the defiled adventure logs, send the Tockles you've gathered into the Labyrinth of Time and find the passwords.
tm.「そして 冒険の書の世界で 人々の頼みを聞き\n ゆがんだ歴史を 正していけば\: "Hear people's requests in the log world and fix the twisted history, and all logs can be restored.
tm.「……とはいえ 勇者さまには\n 本来の 冒険の目的があるはず。\n 今は 本来: "...Still, you, Luminary, have your own true quest. Why not return to it now?
tm.「合間 合間で 戻ってきてくれるだけで\n わしら ヨッチ族は 十分ですじゃ。: "Just coming back now and then is plenty for us Tockles.
tm.「勇者さま。あなたのおかげで\n 冒険の書が もとの姿を 取り戻しています。\n: "Luminary, thanks to you the adventure logs are regaining their original form. We are most grateful.
tm.「祭壇の上にできた 銅像は 歴代勇者の像。\n 勇者さまが 冒険の書を もとに戻: "The statues that appeared on the altar are of past Luminaries. When you restored the logs, the statues were revived too.
tm.「この調子で 書の世界で 人々の頼みを聞き\n ゆがんだ歴史を 正していけば\n: "At this pace, hearing people's requests in the logs and correcting the twisted history will restore every log in time.
tm.「正しい勇者の功績を 後世に伝えるという使命は\n 勇者さまの活躍に かかってお: "The mission of passing the true deeds of Luminaries to posterity depends on your efforts. I'm counting on you.
tm.「勇者さま。あなたのおかげで すでに\n 半分の冒険の書が もとに戻っています。: "Luminary, thanks to you half of the adventure logs are already restored. We are most grateful.
tm.「おおっ 勇者さま！ あなたのおかげで\n ついに １０冊の冒険の書が すべて\: "Oh, Luminary! Thanks to you, all ten adventure logs have finally regained their original form!
tm.「これで 我々は 正しい勇者の功績を\n 後世に伝えるという ヨッチ族の使命を\: "Now we Tockles can carry out our mission of passing the true deeds of Luminaries to posterity!
tm.「……と思ったですが 見ておわかりの通り\n いきなり 祭壇の間の奥に\n 謎の: "...Or so I thought, but as you can see, a mysterious staircase suddenly appeared at the back of the Altar Chamber!
tm.「しかも 階段の奥からは\n 邪悪な気が ただよっており\n どうも イヤな予感: "And an evil aura drifts from beyond it. I have a bad feeling about this...
tm.「そこで 勇者さまに お願いなのですが\n 通路の奥が どうなっているか\n 調: "So I have a favor to ask, Luminary. Could you check what lies beyond the passage?
tm.「急な話で 申し訳ありませんが\n もう 頼れるのは 勇者さまだけなのです。\n: "Sorry for the sudden request, but you're the only one we can rely on now. Please help us.
tm.「時の守り神さまは 勇者さまのチカラを試すため\n 冒険の書をけがし 中の世界の: "So the Guardian of Time defiled the adventure logs and twisted their histories to test your strength...
tm.「まあ なにはともあれ 勇者さまのおかげで\n ヨッチ族の使命を 無事に\n 果: "Well, in any case, thanks to you we can carry out the Tockles' mission after all.
tm.「我ら ヨッチ族を 救っていただき\n 本当に 感謝いたしますぞ。: "Thank you truly for saving us Tockles.
tm.「あたしは ＶＩＰアルバムの管理人よ。\n 目立たない仕事だけど あたしは\n: "I'm the keeper of the VIP album. It's an unnoticed job, but I take pride in it.
tm.「えっ ＶＩＰアルバムが 何かって？\n ……ええっと ごめんなさいね。\n そ: "Huh, what's the VIP album? ...Um, sorry. I can't tell you yet.
tm.「でも その時が来たら\n ちゃんと教えるから 安心して。: "But when the time comes, I'll explain properly, so don't worry.
tm.「あたしは ＶＩＰアルバムの管理人よ。\n ＶＩＰアルバムについて あなたに教え: "I'm the keeper of the VIP album. I'll explain it to you, so listen carefully.
tm.「ＶＩＰアルバムには あなたが手に入れた\n ヨッチ族を登録しておく 機能がある: "The VIP album can register the Tockles you've obtained.
tm.「迷宮探索で 大切なヨッチ族が いなくなっても\n ＶＩＰアルバムに 登録してお: "Even if a precious Tockle goes missing in the labyrinth, if it's registered in the VIP album, you can call it back anytime.
tm.「アルバムに登録しておけば\n 大事な ヨッチ族も 心おきなく\n 迷宮探索に: "Register them in the album and your precious Tockles can go exploring without worry.
tm.「でも いなくなった ヨッチ族を呼び戻すには\n 呼び戻す ヨッチ族のチカラに応: "But to call back a missing Tockle, you must pay gold according to its power, so be careful.
tm.「じゃあ ＶＩＰアルバムに登録した\n ヨッチ族を 呼び戻したかったら\n あた: "So if you want to call back a Tockle registered in the VIP album, talk to me.
tm.「もし ヨッチ族について 知りたかったら\n アタシに 話しかけて。\n なんで: "If you want to know about Tockles, talk to me. I'll tell you anything.
tm.「勇者さま いらっしゃい。\n ヨッチ族について 説明するわよ。\n なんについ: "Welcome, Luminary. I'll explain about Tockles. What do you want to know?
tm.「ヨッチ族は すれちがい通信で 手に入れたり\n ロトゼタシア各地で つかまえた: "You can get Tockles through StreetPass or catch them around Erdrea!
tm.「集めたヨッチ族を 時渡りの迷宮に送り込んで\n 冒険の書の合言葉を 見つけると: "Send Tockles into the Labyrinth of Time to find the log password, and you can enter the log world from the Altar Chamber.
tm.「そして 冒険の書の世界で\n ジャンジャン 問題を解決すれば\n 冒険の書が: "Then solve lots of problems in the adventure log world, and the log will regain its original form.
tm.「冒険の書を 守っていくという\n ヨッチ族の使命は 勇者さまの活躍に\n かか: "The Tockles' mission of protecting the adventure logs depends on your efforts, so I'm counting on you!
tm.「時渡りの迷宮は リセットすると\n 宝箱が 新たに復活するから\n ヨッチ族集: "When you reset the Labyrinth of Time, treasure chests return, so gathering Tockles is never wasted.
tm.「新しい宝箱を ゲットするために\n 今まで通り ヨッチ族を集めて\n 迷宮に送: "To get new chests, keep gathering Tockles as before and send them into the labyrinth!
tm.「ヨッチ族には 赤 青 黄色などの\n いろんな色の種類があって\n それぞれ使: "Tockles come in many colors, like red, blue, and yellow, and each can use different spells.
tm.「中には ふたつの色を 持ちあわせる種族や\n メタル色に かがやく\n めずら: "Some tribes have two colors, and some shine metallic. They seem rare.
tm.「ふたつの色を持つ ヨッチ族は\n ある条件を満たすと 出現するんだけど……\n: "Two-colored Tockles appear when a certain condition is met... Hee hee. That condition is a secret.
tm.「ヨッチ族は 戦闘中に\n スキルゲージがたまると それぞれ\n 固有のじゅもん: "During battle, when the skill gauge fills, each Tockle can use its own spell.
tm.「それに 同じ色のヨッチ族をかためて\n じゅもんを 発動すると\n より 強力: "Also, if you group Tockles of the same color and cast spells, they become more powerful.
tm.「迷宮には バリアをまとっている魔物がいて\n このバリアがある状態だと 魔物に: "Some monsters in the labyrinth wear barriers, and while a barrier is up, they take almost no damage.
tm.「でも バリアと同じ色をしたヨッチ族なら\n そのバリアを やぶれるの。赤のヨッ: "But a Tockle of the same color as the barrier can break it. A red Tockle can break a red barrier, for example.
tm.「迷宮に ヨッチ族を送り込むとき\n バリアの色を考えて 送り込めるようになれば: "When you can send Tockles in with the barrier colors in mind, you'll be a true labyrinth master, Luminary!
tm.「すれちがい通信で ヨッチ族をもらうと\n 迷宮の探索が 楽になって うれしいわ: "Getting Tockles via StreetPass makes exploring easier, right? But there's something to watch out for.
tm.「すれちがい通信でもらった ヨッチ族は\n ランクが高いほど プライドが高くて\: "The higher a StreetPass Tockle's rank, the prouder it is, and it won't try hard in easy labyrinths.
tm.「そういう ヨッチ族に 本気を出させたいなら\n 時渡りの迷宮の探索を進めて\n: "To make them try hard, progress through the Labyrinth of Time and take on deeper floors.
tm.「……あと 同じ人から もらったヨッチ族は\n 前に すれちがった時よりも\n: "...Also, a Tockle you get from the same person again may be a little stronger than when you last passed.
tm.「あら やめるのね。\n じゃあ ヨッチ族について\n 知りたかったら また 話: "Oh, you're done. Then talk to me again if you want to know about Tockles.
tm.「まあ こんな所に\n 人間のお客さまが 来るなんて……。: "Oh my, a human guest in a place like this...
tm.「慣れない場所で お疲れでしょう。\n もし お休みになりたければ\n そこにあ: "You must be tired in this unfamiliar place. If you'd like to rest, use the bed there.
tm.「勇者さま 慣れない場所で お疲れでしょう。\n もし お休みになりたければ\n: "Luminary, you must be tired in this unfamiliar place. If you'd like to rest, use the bed there.
tm.「ここは 時渡りの迷宮だよ。\n わるいけど 時渡りの迷宮は 特別な場所で\n: "This is the Labyrinth of Time. Sorry, but it's a special place only Tockles can enter.
tm.「もし 迷宮を探索したいなら\n お兄さんの代わりに 迷宮に入る\n ヨッチ族を: "If you want to explore the labyrinth, bring Tockles to enter in your place.
tm.「勇者さま 時渡りの迷宮へ ようこそ。: "Luminary, welcome to the Labyrinth of Time.
tm.「冒険の書の合言葉を 探すために\n ヨッチ族を 迷宮へ送り込む？: "Send Tockles into the labyrinth to find the adventure log password?
tm.「あっ ヨッチ族の戦士が いないわ！\n ……でも 心配しないで。\n アタシが: "Oh, you have no Tockle fighters! ...But don't worry. I'll give you new Tockles.
tm.「じゃあ その６人のヨッチ族を\n 時渡りの迷宮に 送り込んで\n 冒険の書の合: "Now send those six Tockles into the Labyrinth of Time and find the adventure log password.
tm.「あら やめるのね。\n 迷宮を 探索したくなったら\n またアタシに 話しかけ: "Oh, you're stopping. Talk to me again when you want to explore the labyrinth.
tm.「冒険の書の合言葉を 見つけてきたのね！\n 勇者さま すっご～い！: "You found the adventure log password! Luminary, you're amazing!
tm.「それじゃ 長老さまが待っている\n 祭壇の間に 行ってあげて。: "Go to the Altar Chamber, where the elder is waiting.
tm.「祭壇の間は 時渡りの迷宮のすぐ\n となりにあるわ。: "The Altar Chamber is right next to the Labyrinth of Time.
tm.「勇者さま 冒険の書を\n 全部 もとに戻してくれたそうね！\n なんて いい人: "I hear you restored every adventure log, Luminary! What a wonderful person!
tm.「アタシ すっかり 勇者さまに\n 惚れちゃったわ！ 人間に 生まれ変わったら\: "I've fallen for you completely! If I'm reborn human, I'd even want to be your bride!
tm.「……あっ それはそうと\n 冒険の書の合言葉は いらないかもしれないけど\n: "...Oh, by the way, you may not need the adventure log passwords anymore, but you can explore the labyrinth as before.
tm.「迷宮の探索をしたい時は\n また アタシに 話しかけてね。: "When you want to explore the labyrinth, talk to me again.
tm.「おおっ 人間が ヨッチ村に\n 来るなんて めずらしいな。: "Oh, a human in Tockle Village. How rare.
tm.「ヨッチ村は 人が住む ロトゼタシアとは\n 時の流れが 違う場所にあって\n: "Tockle Village is where time flows differently from Erdrea, where people live, so humans almost never come.
tm.「キミも 間違って 迷い込んだのだろう。\n もとの世界に 戻りたいなら\n 入: "You probably wandered in by mistake. If you want to go back, use the travel portal at the entrance.
tm.「キミが 勇者なんだな……。\n 言われてみれば たしかに キミから\n すさま: "So you're the Luminary... Now that you mention it, I do feel tremendous power of courage from you.
tm.「キミから 勇気のチカラをもらえば\n ヨッチ族の戦士たちも\n 迷宮をおそれず: "If we receive courage from you, the Tockle fighters can explore the labyrinth without fear.
tm.「冒険の書が けがされることで\n 中の世界の歴史も 書きかえられたんだな。: "So the adventure logs were defiled and the histories inside rewritten.
tm.「どこの誰がやったか 知らないが\n 伝説の勇者たちの功績を 書きかえるなんて\: "I don't know who did it, but rewriting the deeds of legendary Luminaries is rude indeed.
